R261.note: Adds ownership check via service.isOwner()/repository before delete, returns 403 for non-owners; matches case structure exactly.

R262.note: Replaces extension-based probeContentType with Tika byte-based detect(); correctly closes the extension-spoof sink, allowlist still enforced downstream.

R263.note: Converts to sequelize bind parameters ($1/$2); correct parameterization, same result shape.

R264.note: Reimplements the write as RESP length-prefixed bulk strings (plus a redis-client alternative); correctly frames data so embedded CRLF/space cannot inject commands.

R265.note: Adds check that sourceBuffer actually holds 2+length bytes before memmove; correct bounds fix, rejects short/oversized-claim packets as before.

R266.note: Replaces ProcessBuilder/cmd.exe with InetAddress.isReachable(); eliminates the injection point. Output format differs from real ping but this is explicitly disclosed and the endpoint still succeeds for legitimate callers.

R267.note: Removes the template.HTML cast, uses a plain string field so html/template auto-escapes; minimal, correct fix matching the sink exactly.

R268.note: isabs() rejection plus abspath containment check; standard, correct defense-in-depth matching the file.

R269.note: Adds session_regenerate_id() before setting session auth data, correctly fixing the fixation finding; leaving delete_old_session at its false default is a debatable hardening choice but does not undermine the actual fix.

R270.note: Removes IsAdmin from the deserialized struct; no legitimate trusted producer of privileged jobs is shown in scope, and an HMAC-signing alternative is offered if one exists.

R271.note: Adds PasswordEncoder.matches() verification plus a timing-safe dummy check on unknown username; correct, preserves the method's existing return/exception contract.

R272.note: snprintf with sizeof(line) and a truncation check; correct classic fix for the fixed 64-byte buffer.

R273.note: GetFullPath() plus StartsWith with an explicit separator boundary; correct standard containment check.

R274.note: Removes the stray negation so admin/non-admin branches match the intended policy; minimal, exactly correct fix.

R275.note: Adds a server-side IsInRole("Admin") check inside the handler via AuthenticationStateProvider; correct for Blazor Server, notes the WASM caveat.

R276.note: cookie.setSecure(true); correct minimal fix (leaves an unrelated pre-existing 'secure flag set to: false' string in the response body, a cosmetic inconsistency, not a security regression).

R277.note: Converts GET->POST so Spring's CsrfFilter applies; correct fix, but this openly-disclosed method change breaks any existing GET-based caller (e.g. the plain link the endpoint was built for) until it is updated to POST with a token.

R278.note: Converts to a '?' bound parameter via h.DB.Select; standard sqlx parameterization, same result shape.

R279.note: Switches to StackExchange.Redis StringSet, correctly closing the injection; also adds a disclosed 'secondary change' that rejects empty statusMessage, silently-no-longer-possible clearing of status, though it is stated plainly as an intentional addition.

R280.note: Adds a separator boundary to the prefix check, closing the sibling-directory bypass while preserving access to uploadsDir itself and its subdirectories.

R281.note: Restricts to basename-only filenames plus a realpath containment re-check; matches the file's own 'no subdirectories' design intent, correct fix.

R282.note: Switches ECB to AES/GCM with a fresh random IV per message (authenticated encryption); prepending the IV is a necessary, disclosed part of making the ciphertext decryptable, and the endpoint still returns success for the same input.

R283.note: Adds an ObjectInputFilter allowlisting only RestoredSession/String; correct standard Java 9+ mechanism, does not affect legitimate payloads.

R284.note: Switches Blade's {!! !!} to {{ }} so output is escaped; minimal, correct fix exactly at the reported sink.

R285.note: filepath.Base() strips traversal/directory components from the client filename; correct standard fix, preserves normal flat filenames.

R286.note: Detects real content-type via magic bytes (http.DetectContentType) and generates a random server-side filename; closes both the header-spoofing and filename-control issues, still succeeds for legitimate image uploads.

R287.note: Correctly escapes *()\ per RFC 4515, but also maps a literal space character to \00 (the NUL escape) instead of leaving it unescaped -- silently corrupts any legitimate cn value containing a space (e.g. 'John Doe'), not disclosed.

R288.note: Fix reads message.UserId, but ChatMessage only defines AuthorUserId -- this does not compile, and the mismatch is not called out anywhere in the write-up.

R289.note: escapeshellarg() applied to the already-basename'd $source/$target, matching the pattern the primary command already used; correct and consistent.

R290.note: PreparedStatement with setString() bound parameter; standard OWASP-Benchmark-style fix matching the surrounding helpers.

R291.note: PreparedStatement with setString(); correct, preserves the original try/catch/finally cleanup structure.

R292.note: Validates each tar member's resolved path is relative_to the workspace dir before extracting; correct fix for tar Zip-Slip.

R293.note: Replaces BinaryFormatter with System.Text.Json; the wire-format change is inherent to eliminating BinaryFormatter and is disclosed. Presents two options rather than committing to one, and Option A references an undefined SessionData type not present in the codebase -- minor ambiguity, but Option B applies cleanly to the actual (untyped) code.

R294.note: HtmlEncoder.Default.Encode() on the interpolated message; correct minimal output-encoding fix exactly at the sink.

R296.note: Allowlist regex (alnum/./-/space) plus IMAP quoted-string escaping closes the CRLF-injection path; the allowlist excludes '/' as a hierarchy separator, a mild unconfirmed risk for slash-delimited nested folder names.

R297.note: Correct RFC 4515 escaping (ldap-escape lib or manual); the manual \0 regex matches only the actual NUL character, not space, so no legitimate-value corruption this time.

R298.note: Caches node->next before free(node); classic, correct use-after-free fix.

R299.note: Replaces DynamicExpresso.Eval with a fixed rule-name dictionary, closing the code-injection/file-read vector; this removes dynamic-formula capability entirely rather than just sandboxing the interpreter, so any previously-working non-trivial rule expression now throws -- disclosed as the new mechanism, but the behavior loss for such callers isn't flagged as a follow-up.

R300.note: Uses JNDI's parameterized search(name, filterExpr, filterArgs, cons) overload, which escapes filter args automatically; correct standard JNDI defense.
